_: Pickup Time voice casting (Kokoro-82M stock voices, blends of up to 3; pitch in semitones). merge.mjs (voice-attach.mjs) puts each block on its cast member; the table and reasons are in ../VOICES.md. Hand-built people keep their registry voice (public/storykit/cast/registry.json voice.near) under a pt- id; Mog City's Suits keep theirs (their recorded lines play).

john.description: a man of thirty-eight, a warm, slightly tired baritone, even and low, a planner's short sentences; strain under it when it counts

carissa.description: a woman of thirty-six, warm mezzo, quick and funny, a laugh under it and steel when it counts

delgado.description: a man in his fifties, low controlled baritone, quiet and precise, menace under the calm, never shouts

agnes.description: a woman in her seventies, a soft careful alto, formal and apologetic, a faint New York vowel

milo.description: a six-year-old boy, small, clear and high (Kokoro has no child voice: its brightest young voices pitched up the full 2.5 semitones)

teddy.description: a young man, nervous, quick light voice

rollo.description: a thick-set man, amused, gravelly mid voice

lou.description: an older man, gravelly, quick, cheerful

bunny.description: a woman near sixty, smoky low alto, unhurried, amused

pell.description: a man in his forties, nasal, precise, faintly bored

okafor.description: a woman around forty, calm warm teacher voice, crisp, kind and quick

headmaster.description: an older man, precise British tenor-baritone, careful and procedural, kind underneath

ma.description: an older woman, bright and chatty, fast, a warm nasal edge

benny.description: a young man, quick and eager, slightly breathless

calloway.description: a woman of fifty, flat dry low voice, unhurried, amused

odette.description: a woman in her fifties, silky, amused, a little French colour

marjorie.description: a brisk businesswoman, bright, fast, unsentimental

tank.description: a huge man, flat low voice, one word at a time
